transport_records_schema.title: Proposed capture profile transport records v1 (first unit planV2)
x-mandatory-semantic-constraints: All objects have exact fields; JSON parser rejects duplicate keys, invalid UTF8, nonfinite numbers, bool-as-int and values outside strict integer limits. Formal JSON Schema integer alone is not sufficient: stdlib implementation must explicitly reject Python bool and float including1.0 for every integer. Global V3 finite/depth/node/string/canonical and aggregate bounds remain mandatory.

The top-level http_status is the actual last observed final response status; null only when no final status was received. Interim1xx are retained as bounded protocol facts in the private raw journal but never synthesized as a final status. If a nonfinal or malformed status is the only observed line, no valid final status exists and transport_error=invalid_http; retain the actual line privately. A valid unexpected final status remains the actual integer100..599 and uncertain. Never replace known401/5xx bynull/0/200.

response_facts is a truthful observation, not an arbitrary caller claim. body_ref resolves only a fixed private intent/attempt content-addressed member via anchored descriptors, no input path. Its ids equal the receipt; its bytes/SHA equal captured_body_bytes/body_sha256 and exact retained captured bytes. SHA of empty captured bytes is the real SHA256 of empty bytes, notnull or a fake original. No status may coexist with headers_complete=true unless an actual final status and complete headers were received.

captured_body_bytes<=observed_body_bytes<=65537. A bounded one-byte over-limit detector may observe65537 while retaining a clearly labelled65536-byte prefix; body_complete=false/body_limit then. Otherwise every observed body byte is retained, and complete requires observed=captured, valid EOF/HTTP framing, no encoding/length error, no read/timeout and correct Content-Length when present. A limit hit, partial read, missing EOF, malformed framing or incomplete headers is never complete. Body refs never label an observed prefix as a complete server original.

No-status and failed-before-send observations remain uncertain/no positive identity. body_complete=false, headers_complete=false and no supplied resource ID. Mutation not attempted because of missing genuine authority/preflight is a distinct existing typed pending result before this transport receipt, not a fabricated HTTP rejection.

Complete success additionally parses exact endpoint identity from raw JSON under the documented API wire, checks canonical request/source/repository binding and actual server-owned App/monitor or URL identity. A successful status with bad/mismatching/missing/duplicate identity or invalid/truncated/overbound body is uncertain with all actual bytes/status retained; do not salvage a guessed ID. Any parsed candidate ID not yet verified stays in the raw journal only, not the positive receipt.

Known rejected requires a complete bounded finite GitHub JSON error from the fixed authenticated HTTPS API endpoint AND the explicit endpoint classifier in the plan. A status in the schema enum alone does not prove that classifier. HTML/proxy/ambiguous/malformed/missing bodies or unrecognized errors stay uncertain with their actual status. Rejected means this POST was refused, not proof that an earlier attempt/resource does not exist.

A source-ref created_response requires exact returned ref, object.type=commit and SHA=M; it is still not a verified published source pin. Always obtain a separate exact GET readback plus fresh source/authority checks before pin success. Source409/422 are always uncertain-or-existing until exact ref readback, never absent/force-repair. Found exact old ref is recorded in reconciliation without rewriting the original POST receipt.

Actions200 is accepted only when the immutable pre-POST intent requested return_run_details=true and complete JSON provides strict workflow_run_id plus exact fixed-repository run_url/html_url identity. Actions204 is accepted only for the frozen return_run_details=false request and complete empty response; workflow_run_id remainsnull. An unexpected200/204 or body/mode mismatch is uncertain. This source unit fixes normal bridge modefalse for compatibility; the additive low-level typed helper supports trusted fixed true-mode tests but models/envelopes cannot choose it. Future switch of the bridge constant needs reviewed source, not an automatic retry/capability probe.

accepted/posted/created_response signify transport identity or acceptance only, never receiver execution, rehearsal result, capture proof, production Gate, main/source admission, protected approval or merge.

Reconciliation is a NEW immutable record referencing the original immutable attempt receipt and complete ordered metadata index. Never change original status/state/body to match later discovery. Matched identity endpoint must equal record endpoint and bind the exact original repository/purpose/nonce/envelope/comment/source/ref/time/attempt through resolved identity_proof_sha256. A display title or loosely timed run alone is insufficient. A conflict proof retains every conflicting identity privately; missing/overbound/discovery errors are incomplete.

A bounded complete list window with no match is only not_found_in_complete_window, never a remote non-application proof. Uncertain and accepted-with-null-ID attempts cannot be automatically replayed based on absence/expiry/time. Keep discovery-only/pending until exact verified identity and terminal disposition or separate genuinely reviewed safe reconciliation; no undocumented operator override.

Before ANY second POST, resolve/reconcile every earlier intent/attempt and retain bounded discovery even for a prior known rejection. No helper autonomously retries POST, follows authenticated redirects, switches purpose/legacy workflow/ref or reuses a nonce. A retry after a definite refusal additionally requires current same-purpose genuine authority, satisfied backoff and a new explicit intent/nonce; a previously matched action is followed, never duplicated. New worker/operation callers still need their real live control/source/full-row CAS at the boundary.

Credential source is the existing trusted GH_TOKEN environment and fixed repository binding, never gh.token, a model argument or a request body. No credentials/request headers/redirect URL/opaque exception text enter artifacts. Safe header fields are parsed bounded allowlist values, not unrestricted copies. Exact secret-taint detection blocks raw artifact exposure; preserve private quarantine/hash and an explicit incomplete/private-only delivery fact rather than pretending safely delivered complete original. Public/model views are redacted copies; raw nonsecret response originals remain immutable under the joint retention budget.

implementation_file_contract: The protected capture_receiver.schema.json remains the exact unchanged globalV3 receiver schema bytes, not this bundle wrapper. New transport shapes/semantics are fixed stdlib validators in capture_receiver.py/controller paths with tests; no second arbitrary runtime schema loader, jsonschema dependency or mutation to global purpose/admission schemas.
